saqPsd22024109.description: Unplanned unavailability or a systems breakdown may be presumed to have arisen when five consecutive requests for access to information for the provision of payment initiation services or account information services are not replied to within 30 seconds.

saqPsd22024111.title: Was there any period of more than 2 consecutive calendar weeks where the conditions a) and d) of Article 33(6) of the RTS were not met by your institution during the reference period?
saqPsd22024111.description: The CSSF shall revoke the fallback mechanism exemption referred to in Article 33(6) where the conditions (a) and (d) are not met by the account servicing payment service providers for more than 2 consecutive calendar weeks.
